import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlPair254

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
The actual AX parameter read at controls181..194, exiting at195. The
checked internal ReadShape theorem supplies unbounded execution; all
fourteen literal edges and nineteen resolved successors are bound here.
The next PL component is added to the old TW, with every other field except
PL retained. Both scratch registers initially vanish; TW is arbitrary.
The following constructor and remaining AX composition are separate.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXReadTW254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open ArithmeticCantor ArithmeticControlRun254 ArithmeticControlFrame254
open ArithmeticControlStep254 ArithmeticControlReadTemplate254
open ArithmeticControlFetch254 (put s1Reg plReg)
open ArithmeticControlRead254 (s2Reg)
open ArithmeticControlPair254 (twReg)
open FiniteControlTable254 RegisterPath

def entry : Control := ⟨181, by decide⟩
def exit : Control := ⟨195, by decide⟩

theorem entry_source : source entry =
    ([true,true,true,false,true,false,false,true,false,false,true,false,true,false,false,false,true,false,true,false,false,false,false], .decnz 8) := by rfl

theorem exit_source : source exit =
    ([true,true,true,false,true,false,false,true,false,false,true,false,true,false,false,false,true,false,true,true,false,false,false], .decnz 2) := by rfl

private def twReadShape : ReadShape where
  readEntry := entry
  bodyIncS2 := ⟨182, by decide⟩
  bodyTestS1 := ⟨183, by decide⟩
  bodyBreak := ⟨184, by decide⟩
  bodyMoveTest := ⟨185, by decide⟩
  bodyMoveInc := ⟨186, by decide⟩
  bodyMoveContinue := ⟨187, by decide⟩
  bodyContinue := ⟨188, by decide⟩
  restorePLTest := ⟨189, by decide⟩
  restorePLInc := ⟨190, by decide⟩
  restorePLContinue := ⟨191, by decide⟩
  outputTest := ⟨192, by decide⟩
  outputInc := ⟨193, by decide⟩
  outputContinue := ⟨194, by decide⟩
  nextRead := exit
  targetLogical := 1
  targetIndex := twReg
  target_physical := rfl
  target_ne_s1 := by decide
  target_ne_s2 := by decide
  target_ne_pl := by decide
  read_edge := by rfl
  body_inc_edge := by rfl
  body_test_edge := by rfl
  body_break_edge := by rfl
  body_move_test_edge := by rfl
  body_move_inc_edge := by rfl
  body_move_continue_edge := by rfl
  body_continue_edge := by rfl
  restore_test_edge := by rfl
  restore_inc_edge := by rfl
  restore_continue_edge := by rfl
  output_test_edge := by rfl
  output_inc_edge := by rfl
  output_continue_edge := by rfl
  next_read_positive := by rfl
  next_read_zero := by rfl
  next_body_inc := by rfl
  next_body_test_positive := by rfl
  next_body_test_zero := by rfl
  next_body_break := by rfl
  next_body_move_positive := by rfl
  next_body_move_inc := by rfl
  next_body_move_continue := by rfl
  next_body_move_zero := by rfl
  next_body_continue := by rfl
  next_restore_pl_positive := by rfl
  next_restore_pl_inc := by rfl
  next_restore_pl_continue := by rfl
  next_restore_pl_zero := by rfl
  next_output_positive := by rfl
  next_output_inc := by rfl
  next_output_continue := by rfl
  next_output_zero := by rfl

section Model
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

/-- Consume PL's first Cantor component into the existing TW. -/
def twReadFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file twReg + first (regValue file plReg))
    (put plReg (second (regValue file plReg)) file)

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p

private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h

theorem twReadFile_tw (file : V) :
    regValue (twReadFile file) twReg =
      regValue file twReg + first (regValue file plReg) := by
  rw [twReadFile, read_put_self]

theorem twReadFile_pl (file : V) :
    regValue (twReadFile file) plReg = second (regValue file plReg) := by
  rw [twReadFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg plReg (by decide), read_put_self]

theorem twReadFile_other (file : V) (i : Fin 9)
    (hc : i ≠ twReg) (hp : i ≠ plReg) :
    regValue (twReadFile file) i = regValue file i := by
  rw [twReadFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg i hc.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ plReg i hp.symm]

/-- All values and the positive runtime belong to the ambient IΣ₁ model. -/
theorem read_tw_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number entry : V) file) =
        liveValue (number exit : V) (twReadFile file) := by
  exact read_shape twReadShape file h1 h2

/-- A parameter-stream client, allowing arbitrary old TW and remaining tail. -/
theorem read_tw_pair_run (file x rest : V)
    (hp : regValue file plReg = cantor x rest)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number entry : V) file) =
        liveValue (number exit : V)
          (put twReg (regValue file twReg + x) (put plReg rest file)) := by
  simpa only [twReadFile, hp, first_cantor, second_cantor] using
    read_tw_run file h1 h2

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXReadTW254

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlPair254

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

/-!
The actual AX parameter read at controls181..194, exiting at195. The
checked internal ReadShape theorem supplies unbounded execution; all
fourteen literal edges and nineteen resolved successors are bound here.
The next PL component is added to the old TW, with every other field except
PL retained. Both scratch registers initially vanish; TW is arbitrary.
The following constructor and remaining AX composition are separate.
-/
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXReadTW254
open LO LO.FirstOrder LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open scoped LO.FirstOrder.Arithmetic
open ArithmeticCantor ArithmeticControlRun254 ArithmeticControlFrame254
open ArithmeticControlStep254 ArithmeticControlReadTemplate254
open ArithmeticControlFetch254 (put s1Reg plReg)
open ArithmeticControlRead254 (s2Reg)
open ArithmeticControlPair254 (twReg)
open FiniteControlTable254 RegisterPath

def entry : Control := ⟨181, by decide⟩
def exit : Control := ⟨195, by decide⟩

theorem entry_source : source entry =
    ([true,true,true,false,true,false,false,true,false,false,true,false,true,false,false,false,true,false,true,false,false,false,false], .decnz 8) := by rfl

theorem exit_source : source exit =
    ([true,true,true,false,true,false,false,true,false,false,true,false,true,false,false,false,true,false,true,true,false,false,false], .decnz 2) := by rfl

/-- Resolve a literal target through its finite tree path, avoiding catalogue search. -/
private theorem literal_target (P : List Bool) (q : Control)
    (hw : RMBisim.twalk ActualTree254.tree P 0 =
      some ((source q).2, (source q).1.length))
    (hc : consume P (source q).1.length = (source q).1) : resolveControl P = q := by
  have hw' : walk Prog254.program (Prog254.program.nnodes + 1) Prog254.program.root P 0 =
      some ((source q).2, (source q).1.length) := by
    rw [RMBisim.walk_root, ActualTree254.tree_eq]
    exact hw
  apply source_injective
  rw [resolve_source _ _ _ hw', hc]

private def twReadShape : ReadShape where
  readEntry := entry
  bodyIncS2 := ⟨182, by decide⟩
  bodyTestS1 := ⟨183, by decide⟩
  bodyBreak := ⟨184, by decide⟩
  bodyMoveTest := ⟨185, by decide⟩
  bodyMoveInc := ⟨186, by decide⟩
  bodyMoveContinue := ⟨187, by decide⟩
  bodyContinue := ⟨188, by decide⟩
  restorePLTest := ⟨189, by decide⟩
  restorePLInc := ⟨190, by decide⟩
  restorePLContinue := ⟨191, by decide⟩
  outputTest := ⟨192, by decide⟩
  outputInc := ⟨193, by decide⟩
  outputContinue := ⟨194, by decide⟩
  nextRead := exit
  targetLogical := 1
  targetIndex := twReg
  target_physical := rfl
  target_ne_s1 := by decide
  target_ne_s2 := by decide
  target_ne_pl := by decide
  read_edge := by rfl
  body_inc_edge := by rfl
  body_test_edge := by rfl
  body_break_edge := by rfl
  body_move_test_edge := by rfl
  body_move_inc_edge := by rfl
  body_move_continue_edge := by rfl
  body_continue_edge := by rfl
  restore_test_edge := by rfl
  restore_inc_edge := by rfl
  restore_continue_edge := by rfl
  output_test_edge := by rfl
  output_inc_edge := by rfl
  output_continue_edge := by rfl
  next_read_positive := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_read_zero := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_inc := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_test_positive := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_test_zero := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_break := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_move_positive := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_move_inc := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_move_continue := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_move_zero := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_body_continue := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_restore_pl_positive := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_restore_pl_inc := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_restore_pl_continue := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_restore_pl_zero := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_output_positive := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_output_inc := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_output_continue := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl
  next_output_zero := by
    apply literal_target <;> rfl

section Model
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

/-- Consume PL's first Cantor component into the existing TW. -/
def twReadFile (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (regValue file twReg + first (regValue file plReg))
    (put plReg (second (regValue file plReg)) file)

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p

private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h

theorem twReadFile_tw (file : V) :
    regValue (twReadFile file) twReg =
      regValue file twReg + first (regValue file plReg) := by
  rw [twReadFile, read_put_self]

theorem twReadFile_pl (file : V) :
    regValue (twReadFile file) plReg = second (regValue file plReg) := by
  rw [twReadFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg plReg (by decide), read_put_self]

theorem twReadFile_other (file : V) (i : Fin 9)
    (hc : i ≠ twReg) (hp : i ≠ plReg) :
    regValue (twReadFile file) i = regValue file i := by
  rw [twReadFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg i hc.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ plReg i hp.symm]

/-- All values and the positive runtime belong to the ambient IΣ₁ model. -/
theorem read_tw_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number entry : V) file) =
        liveValue (number exit : V) (twReadFile file) := by
  exact read_shape twReadShape file h1 h2

/-- A parameter-stream client, allowing arbitrary old TW and remaining tail. -/
theorem read_tw_pair_run (file x rest : V)
    (hp : regValue file plReg = cantor x rest)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number entry : V) file) =
        liveValue (number exit : V)
          (put twReg (regValue file twReg + x) (put plReg rest file)) := by
  simpa only [twReadFile, hp, first_cantor, second_cantor] using
    read_tw_run file h1 h2

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlAXReadTW254

# Internal AX read into TW

[ArithmeticControlAXReadTW254](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/ArithmeticControlAXReadTW254.lean) proves the actual AX read at catalogue controls **181→195**. In any internal model of IΣ₁, with both scratch coordinates initially zero, it supplies a positive internal execution time and the complete output register file:

- `TW := oldTW + first(oldPL)`;
- `PL := second(oldPL)`;
- every other coordinate retains its old value.

The input TW, PL, and all other register values are arbitrary elements of the arithmetic model. The paired-stream client accepts `PL = cantor(x, rest)` and returns `TW = oldTW + x`, `PL = rest`. The proof instantiates the existing `ReadShape` theorem with all fourteen actual instruction edges and nineteen resolved successor equalities. It adds no execution premise or new induction.

The [typed audit](arithmetic_control_ax_read_tw254_audit.lean) contains seven named axiom probes and twelve callers. They cover the entry and exit, both changed coordinates, arbitrary other-coordinate preservation, both runtime contracts, cache/WS/scratch preservation, and the zero-TW specialization. The first actual source/audit run passed in 22.873 and 2.214 seconds, respectively, with zero warnings. The first two reports use `propext`; the other five use only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. See the exact [verification record](results/arithmetic-control-ax-read-tw254-verification.json) and [independent review](results/arithmetic-control-ax-read-tw254-review.json).

The original draft used direct reductions of the catalogue resolver. Before any ReadTW compilation, those nineteen proof bodies were replaced by the finite actual-tree walk helper already used in the constructor unit. The helper uses the checked program/tree identity, `resolve_source`, and `source_injective`; its literal targets are unchanged. No failed ReadTW proof run preceded this PASS. The [history](results/arithmetic-control-ax-read-tw254-history.json) retains that uncompiled draft, the proactive helper repair, both source versions, the exact executed guard, raw preparation and successful run records/logs, source-only reviews, and root receipts. It also preserves the root's reported initial metadata-inspection schema error, which did not run a compiler.

The guard selects 96 project providers from the exact checked Pair parent. It verifies five directly imported Foundation/Mathlib boundaries, separately retains the inherited `HFS.Seq` source/object pair, and binds Init/Omega. The Pair parent recorded its source object before audit but did not have the later separate first-provider field; its recorded search path is resolved now and that limitation remains explicit. ReadTW records both its fresh source object and its actual first provider before running the audit.

The maintained [guard](check_arithmetic_control_ax_read_tw254.py) changes only the source, audit, and provider-proposal default paths from the executed guard. Replay requires the exact historical cached providers in [the provider proposal](results/arithmetic-control-ax-read-tw254-provider-proposal.json) and verification record. No compiled caches are distributed, and this packet does not certify a clean-checkout dependency build. Preparation uses no Lean or version query:

```sh
python3 -B Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/check_arithmetic_control_ax_read_tw254.py \
  --repo "$PWD" \
  --dependency-root /path/to/the/recorded/dependency-root \
  --pair-evidence Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-pair254-verification.json \
  --output /tmp/fresh-ax-read-tw-preparation \
  --prepare-only
```

After reviewing that preparation, omitting `--prepare-only` in a fresh output directory runs source and audit under default proof limits, one thread, a 4,096 MiB memory limit, and one shared 120-second budget. This unit covers only controls 181→195; the complete AX branch, interpreter/Enum comparison, and internal binary consistency equivalence remain separate obligations.

The shared register program is Mira-Cult's, imported from Jeff's verification; the original TMBuilder framework is Wade's. [Prog254.lean](../../Lean/BusyBeaver/ZFC/Prog254.lean) records the source and attribution.
